description: Search Reddit by keywords with advanced filters, comment search, and only-new monitoring. Sources: rendered Reddit search (challenge-solved browser), Redlib, Google Translate community partial, Arctic Shift archive, optional user OAuth token, and RSS only through its 2026-11-13 retirement.

commentLimit.description: Maximum matching comments per keyword when searchComments is enabled (1-1000).
commentLimit.title: Comment limit per keyword

dateFrom.description: Drop records with `created_at` before this date (inclusive). Format: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO timestamp.
dateFrom.title: Date from (YYYY-MM-DD)

dateTo.description: Drop records with `created_at` after this date (inclusive end-of-day). Format: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO timestamp.
dateTo.title: Date to (YYYY-MM-DD)

excludeNsfw.description: Drop NSFW records. Posts whose NSFW flag is unknown are not emitted as safe; comments without their own flag are kept fail-soft and counted as nsfwUnknown in the status record.
excludeNsfw.title: Exclude NSFW

includeArchive.description: Use Arctic Shift for subreddit-scoped backfill, comment hydration, and by-ID enrichment of rendered-search posts/comments. Enrichment fills missing content, domain, flair, media, crosspost, edited and body_html fields; it never overwrites live metrics. Archive metrics are snapshots, not live.
includeArchive.title: Include Arctic Shift archive fallback

keywordRequireAll.description: When multiple keywords are given, keep only records whose title, content, or comment body contains ALL of them. Default: each keyword runs independently (OR).
keywordRequireAll.title: Require all keywords (AND)

keywords.description: List of keywords to search. Each runs as a separate search.
keywords.title: Keywords

maxAgeDays.description: Drop records older than N days.
maxAgeDays.title: Max post age in days (filter)

minScore.description: Drop records below this score. Applied when the source exposes a score; archive scores are timestamped snapshots and are filtered as snapshots. Sources without any score are reported as metrics_unavailable instead of silently passing/dropping.
minScore.title: Min score (filter)

monitorId.description: Key used to store the onlyNew watermark and seen IDs. Use the same value on every scheduled run of the same monitor.
monitorId.title: Monitor ID

onlyNew.description: Emit only records newer than the stored watermark for this monitorId. Forces sort=new so sources return recent records first. Requires a stable monitorId for scheduled runs; when omitted, a stable id is derived from the keyword set.
onlyNew.title: Only new since last run

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify proxy configuration, used by both HTTP sources and the Playwright browser session. Live HTML availability varies by IP; residential proxies improve success on datacenter runs.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

redditOAuthToken.description: Optional user-supplied OAuth Bearer token. Never required; when present, oauth.reddit.com is tried first for live metrics. The actor does not obtain tokens for you.
redditOAuthToken.title: Optional Reddit OAuth token

redlibInstances.description: Optional Redlib hostnames to try in order (without https://). Defaults to redlib-1.privadency.com and red.artemislena.eu (the same defaults as the code and README).
redlibInstances.title: Redlib instances

relativeWindow.description: Restrict results to a relative window. Maps to Reddit's t= and Arctic after= filters. Use all for no window.
relativeWindow.title: Relative time window

resolveChallenges.description: Allow Playwright to solve Reddit/Redlib challenges and render the search page. Disable to skip the browser path and keep the HTTP-only sources (Translate, Redlib HTTP, Arctic); the rendered global search and the Redlib browser fallback are then unavailable.
resolveChallenges.title: Resolve browser challenges

resultLimit.description: Max posts per keyword (1-1000). Default 100. Source caps are real: rendered search returns one page at a time, Translate partial 24/page, Redlib 7/page, Arctic 100/page, RSS 100/request (retired after 2026-11-13). Fewer results are reported as partial rather than silently truncated.
resultLimit.title: Result limit per keyword

searchComments.description: Also search comment bodies in the rendered Reddit search, Redlib, and Arctic (subreddit-scoped), with RSS parent-post discovery + hydration as a fallback. Emits recordType=comment records.
searchComments.title: Search comments by keyword

sort.description: How to sort the search results.
sort.title: Sort by

subredditFilter.description: Only emit posts/comments from these subreddits (with or without `r/`). Empty = all. When set, the engine prefers subreddit-scoped sources (Translate listing, rendered subreddit search, Arctic).
subredditFilter.title: Subreddit filter (allowlist)

title: Reddit Keywords Pro Input
